title: How to build and train your recurrent-depth model: A fixed-point perspective
abstract: arXiv:2611.31513v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recurrent-depth models are trained with truncated backpropagation, yet it remains unclear why this works. We show that input injection, commonly used in recurrent-depth models, is exactly Halpern iteration, and that a slowly vanishing stepsize provably converges with a backpropagation window polylogarithmic in the depth. The guarantees require a Lipschitz operator, which for SwiGLU leads to a weight constraint in both row and spectral norm, while only a row norm constraint for gates. Based on these constraints, we develop an optimizer tailored to each parameter group, Sparrow, which provides a drop-in replacement of Muon/MuonH with no overhead, that speeds up training even beyond recurrent models.

translated_title: 如何构建和训练你的循环深度模型：不动点视角
translated_abstract: 循环深度模型使用截断反向传播进行训练，但其为何有效仍不明确。我们证明了循环深度模型中常用的输入注入恰好等价于Halpern迭代，并且缓慢消失的步长在反向传播窗口仅为深度的多对数级别时可证明收敛。这些理论保证要求算子满足Lipschitz条件，对于SwiGLU这意味着权重需要同时满足行范数和谱范数约束，而对于门控机制则只需行范数约束。基于这些约束，我们为每个参数组量身定制了一个优化器Sparrow，它可作为Muon/MuonH的无缝替代品且无额外开销，甚至在循环模型之外也能加速训练。
tldr: 该论文从不动点理论视角揭示了循环深度模型中输入注入本质上就是Halpern迭代，证明了截断反向传播仅需多对数深度的窗口即可保证收敛，并据此开发了无额外开销的Sparrow优化器，可无缝替换Muon/MuonH并加速训练。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals from a fixed-point perspective that input injection in recurrent-depth models is exactly Halpern iteration, proves that truncated backpropagation converges with a polylogarithmic window, and develops Sparrow, a drop-in overhead-free replacement for Muon/MuonH that accelerates training even beyond recurrent models.
